channel.title: Anchor Host incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Anchor Host's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: WordPress 7.1 + WP Rocket PHP Fatal [resolved]
item.description:
WP Rocket doesn't have a patch yet so we patched it directly with our v3.23.2.2. All customers affected with the WP Rocket + WordPress 7.1 compatible issue should be restored. Whenever WP Rocket does release an official fix, customers should automatically upgrade to that.
There were a few other plugins with similar compatible issues with v7.1. Reviewing and fixing as I discover them.

item.title: Kinsta Server Outage [resolved]
item.description: The server has been stabilized. All customer websites should be restored.

item.title: Cloudflare outage [resolved]
item.description: All customer website appears to be restored and healthy. Will continue to monitor the Cloudflare situation: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/8gmgl950y3h7.
